name: order_analytics
title: Order Analytics Template
description: Monitor order pipeline, fulfillment metrics, and order status distribution. Perfect for operations teams.
use_case: Track order status, monitor fulfillment rates, identify bottlenecks in the order pipeline

sources.name: orders
sources.description: Orders table with status and priority information

dimensions.name: order_date
dimensions.description: Date when the order was created

dimensions.name: order_month
dimensions.description: Order month for monthly trend analysis

dimensions.name: order_status
dimensions.description: Current order status (Open, Processing, Fulfilled, Cancelled)

dimensions.name: is_high_priority
dimensions.expression: CASE WHEN priority = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: open_orders
measures.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'Open' THEN id END)

measures.name: fulfilled_orders
measures.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'Fulfilled' THEN id END)

measures.name: open_order_value
measures.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Open' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END)
measures.description: Total value of open orders (at risk)

measures.name: fulfillment_rate
measures.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'Fulfilled' THEN id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)
measures.description: Percentage of orders that are fulfilled
